newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Dec 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Dec 31.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
Up to six inches of snow fell in Kent and Sussex bringing chaos to the roads. Daytime temperatures in London are forecast to stay below freezing for the next three days.
BRITISH BANKS SET FOR A TELECOMS BONANZA
British banks will benefit from a bumper crop of telecommunications privatisations and shares sales planned for 1997. The banks plan to cash in on multi-billion dollar sell-offs yielding hefty fees.
A SHORTER HAUL FOR OZ AIRPORTS SELL-OFF
Australia's government will cut three months off of the planned airport privatisation process. Three British companies have expressed interest including BAA, National Express and Manchester Airport.
BULLS LOOK FOR NEW FTSE GAINS AS POUND STAYS STRONG
The FTSE 100 was pushed to new highs yesterday while sterling continued to dally with recent records. Economists argued that sterling strength meant there was no need for a rate rise.
